MILAAN · SERVICE TERMS

Terms & Conditions

Milaan is an independent software project operated by Bilal Ahmed, an individual founder in Pakistan. Milaan is not yet a registered company and has no registered business office.

Draft for legal review — not finalized or effective terms. Prepared 25 October 2026. The operator must confirm the remaining terms and obtain legal review before publishing an effective version. Public registration remains closed until real email verification is tested and activation is approved.

Purpose and limits

Milaan compares orders, payment screenshots and statements supplied by sellers. SHIP, HOLD and REVIEW are evidence-based suggestions, not bank confirmation, a fraud determination or a guarantee of settlement. Milaan does not move money or act as a bank or payment processor.

Your decisions and records

You remain responsible for verifying the receiving account, amount, statement coverage, full Transaction ID, payment status and other evidence before shipping, refunding or taking action. Only upload records you are entitled to process. Keep independent copies of records you need to retain; working batches normally expire after seven days. See the Privacy Policy draft for deletion limitations.

Accounts and acceptable use

Protect your account credentials and do not share verification codes or recovery links. Do not attempt to access another seller's records, bypass security controls, upload malicious content or use the service unlawfully. Eligibility, age requirements, suspension procedures and account-closure terms remain to be finalized after legal review.

AI assistance

Optional Gemini receipt reading requires your consent and may misread details. Check extracted values against the original screenshot and statement. Uncertain or conflicting evidence requires human review; an AI result is not independent proof of payment.

Availability and commercial terms

Availability may vary while the project is being developed. No paid subscription, service-level commitment or refund policy is established by this draft. Pricing, billing, cancellation and refund terms must be published before paid plans are offered.

Rights and responsibilities still under review

Service-use permissions, intellectual-property terms, warranties, liability limits, dispute procedures and changes to these terms require qualified legal review. This draft does not impose an unreviewed liability waiver or remove any applicable statutory rights.

Governing jurisdiction and contact

The proposed governing jurisdiction is Pakistan, subject to legal review. Applicable mandatory laws and the appropriate dispute forum remain to be confirmed. A support email is not configured yet; a private contact method and any legally required service address must be established before these terms are finalized. Do not post sensitive records in public issues.
